verdict.rationale: Docs show a user-controlled Model Improvement privacy setting, with chats used for training only 'when you allow us'. Incognito chats are never used to improve Claude, even with that setting on, and Gmail, Drive and Calendar connector data is never used for training. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to switch Model Improvement off and what the default is, coverage of other data types and plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
